scope: Weight-free fixed-length dense Qwen3-1.7B architecture predictions. No numerical inference, generated text, EOS or evolved-RTL validation. Hardware cycles, simulator seconds and assumed-clock latency are reported separately.

assumptions.bank_conflicts: TMEM strided output ports modeled; HBM bank conflicts and detailed controller queues not modeled.

workload.byte_scope: Matrix data/scales, LD/ST and QST data; excludes QST scale writes, controller overhead and padding. No persistent weight cache assumed.

resources.scope: Capacity/throughput screening only. DSP packing is assumed; non-MXU DSPs, LUTs, shell, routing, bank implementation and achievable Fmax require synthesis. Reserves are configurable.
